## Sdks > Python > Tracing
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/add-event — add_event() — Add a timestamped event to the current span.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/export-spans — process_spans() — Process collected spans through the processor pipeline.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/flush — flush() — Force flush all pending spans to exporters.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-client — get_client() — Get the RespanClient for span and trace operations.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-context-value — get_context_value() — Read a value from the current OpenTelemetry context.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-current-span-id — get_current_span_id() — Return the active span ID as a hex string.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-current-trace-id — get_current_trace_id() — Return the active trace ID as a hex string.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-span-buffer — get_span_buffer() — Buffer spans in a context for manual batch collection and export.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/get-tracer — get_tracer() — Access the OpenTelemetry tracer for manual span creation.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/is-recording — is_recording() — Check if the current span is actively recording.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/record-exception — record_exception() — Record an exception on the current span and set error status.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/set-context-value — set_context_value() — Set a value in the current OpenTelemetry context.
- /sdks/python/tracing/client/update-current-span — update_current_span() — Update name, status, attributes, and Respan params on the current span.
- /sdks/python/tracing/contexts/respan-span-attributes — respan_span_attributes() — Context manager to attach Respan-specific attributes to spans.
- /sdks/python/tracing/decorators/agent — @agent — Mark a function or class as a traced agent span.
- /sdks/python/tracing/decorators/task — @task — Trace a single operation within a workflow as a child span.
- /sdks/python/tracing/decorators/tool — @tool — Trace a tool execution within an agent or workflow.

## Sdks > Typescript > Tracing
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/add-span-event — addSpanEvent() — Add a timestamped event to the current span

- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/get-client — getClient() — Access the Respan client for span and trace operations
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/get-context-value — getContextValue() — Get a value from the trace context by key

- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/get-current-trace-id — getCurrentTraceId() — Get the current trace ID

- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/initialize — initialize() — Initialize the Respan telemetry client
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/is-recording — isRecording() — Check if tracing is currently active
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/record-span-exception — recordSpanException() — Record an error or exception on the current span
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/set-context-value — setContextValue() — Set a value in the trace context by key
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/shutdown — shutdown() — Gracefully shutdown the tracing client and flush all pending spans
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/client/update-current-span — updateCurrentSpan() — Update name, status, attributes, and Respan params on the current span

- /sdks/typescript/tracing/instrumentation/overview — Automatic Instrumentation — Auto-instrument popular libraries like OpenAI and Anthropic
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/methods/with-agent — withAgent() — Wrap an async function as a traced agent
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/methods/with-task — withTask() — Wrap an async function as a traced task
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/methods/with-tool — withTool() — Wrap an async function as a traced tool
- /sdks/typescript/tracing/methods/with-workflow — withWorkflow() — Wrap an async function as a traced workflow
